description: Startup environment variables (read only) and the runtime settings locked by environment variables. Secret values are never returned.

id.description: The group: network, users, nginx, modules, goaccess, database or certificates-account

value.description: The effective value; left out for a secret variable

default.description: The default value; null for a secret variable

is_default.description: Whether the variable is not set or equals its default

secret.description: Whether the variable holds a credential or personal data; its value is never returned

set.description: Whether the variable was set when the container started

setting.description: The settings section that also holds this variable as a setting applied after a restart; without the variable, value is the one that section has

groups.description: The startup variables, grouped as the Environment page shows them

locked_runtime.description: Settings locked by an environment variable (read only in the UI): the runtime settings groups and the oidc, monitoring and geoip settings, in settings menu order

group.description: The settings section the locked setting belongs to

key.description: The name of the locked setting in that section

env.description: The environment variable that locks it (the name only, never its value)

reason.description: Why a variable of another setting locks it; null when the setting's own variable sets it
